dialogues.pinyin: Huǒ chē piào ná chū lái le ma?

dialogues.pinyin: Ná chū lái le, zài zhè lǐ.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Bà ba, zhè shì nǐ de ba?

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐

dialogues.speaker: 张伟

dialogues.pinyin: Yí? wǒ jì de yǒu sì zhāng.
dialogues.tr: Aa? Dört tane vardı diye hatırlıyorum.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.zh: 这是我的，这张是妈妈的。
dialogues.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de, zhè zhāng shì mā ma de.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Méi yǒu wǒ de huǒ chē piào ma?

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Zhè lǐ méi yǒu, nǐ de zài nǎr?

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Lè le, gāng cái nǐ ná guò piào ma?
dialogues.tr: Lele, az önce bileti aldın mı?

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Nǐ shuō yào zì jǐ ná zhe de.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Duì, wǒ xiǎng kàn kàn huǒ chē piào.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Kàn wán fàng nǎr le?

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Bié jí, màn màn xiǎng.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Shì bú shì fàng zài bāo lǐ le?

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ kàn kàn…… zhè lǐ méi yǒu.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Bǎ bāo dǎ kāi yì diǎn.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Xiān kàn kàn lǐ miàn yǒu shén me.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Yǒu nǐ de xiǎo chē, hái yǒu shuǐ.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Hái yǒu wǒ de xiǎo bǐng gān.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Bǐng gān páng biān yǒu méi yǒu piào?

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ lái bāng nǐ ná zhe shuǐ.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ xiǎo chē ná chū lái.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Zhè xià miàn yě méi yǒu ya.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.zh: 别把包里的东西弄丢了。
dialogues.pinyin: Bié bǎ bāo lǐ de dōng xi nòng diū le.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Dōu fàng zài zhuō shàng ba.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Shuǐ zài zhè biān, xiǎo chē zài nà biān.
dialogues.tr: Su bu tarafta, oyuncak araba o tarafta.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ de piào huì bú huì zài zhuō shàng?

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Zhuō shàng zhǐ yǒu wǒ men de sān zhāng.
dialogues.tr: Masada sadece bizim üç biletimiz var.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bié ná zhè xiē piào.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Mā ma, nǐ bǎ tā men fàng hǎo ba.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ zhǐ zhǎo zì jǐ de.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Nǐ gāng cái qù guò fáng jiān ma?

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Tā qù ná shū le.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Shū yǐ jīng fàng jìn xiāng zi le.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Kě shì piào bù zài shū lǐ.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Nǐ zěn me zhī dào de?

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Shì bú shì jì qǐ shén me le?

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.zh: 乐乐，你看过票上的字吗？
dialogues.pinyin: Lè le, nǐ kàn guò piào shàng de zì ma?
dialogues.tr: Lele, biletin üstündeki yazıya baktın mı?

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.zh: 看过，我看见自己的名字了。
dialogues.pinyin: Kàn guò, wǒ kàn jiàn zì jǐ de míng zi le.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.zh: 然后呢？拿着票去哪儿了？
dialogues.pinyin: Rán hòu ne? ná zhe piào qù nǎr le?

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Shì lái zhǎo mā ma le ma?

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Nà shí hòu wǒ zài mén páng biān.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.zh: 我给姐姐看了我的名字。
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ gěi jiě jie kàn le wǒ de míng zi.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Yǔ tóng, nǐ hái jì de ma?

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Nǐ men liǎng gè dōu xiǎng xiǎng.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Jì de, tā shuō jīn tiān zuò huǒ chē.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ hái shuō yào zuò chuāng biān!
dialogues.tr: Bir de pencerenin yanında oturacağımı söyledim!

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Xiān yǒu piào, cái néng shàng huǒ chē.
dialogues.tr: Trene binebilmek için önce bilet lazım.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Chuāng biān de shì děng huì er zài shuō.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.zh: 我当时让你把票放进包里。
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ dāng shí ràng nǐ bǎ piào fàng jìn bāo lǐ.
dialogues.tr: O sırada sana bileti çantana koymanı söyledim.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Duì a, wǒ fàng le ya.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Nà zài kàn kàn nǐ de bāo.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Zhè ge xiǎo kǒu dai dǎ kāi le ma?

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.zh: 这里还有一个小口袋呢。
dialogues.pinyin: Zhè lǐ hái yǒu yí gè xiǎo kǒu dai ne.
dialogues.tr: Burada bir küçük cep daha var.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ gāng cái zhǐ kàn le lǐ miàn.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Xiān bǎ zhè ge dǎ kāi.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Màn yì diǎn, bié lā huài le.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ bāng nǐ bǎ bāo ná hǎo.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: A, zhè lǐ yǒu yī zhāng zhǐ!

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Ná chū lái kàn kàn, shì piào ma?

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Bié bǎ tā sī le.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.zh: 有名字，也有车站的名字。
dialogues.pinyin: Yǒu míng zi, yě yǒu chē zhàn de míng zi.
dialogues.tr: Üstünde bir ad ve istasyonun adı var.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Shì wǒ de! zhǎo dào le!

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Hǎo, gěi bà ba kàn yī xià.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Míng zi shì duì de ma?

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Shì zhāng lè le, jiù shì tā de.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu huǒ chē piào le!

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.zh: 你一直都有，只是没找到。
dialogues.pinyin: Nǐ yì zhí dōu yǒu, zhǐ shì méi zhǎo dào.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Xiàn zài fàng xīn le ba?

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Xiǎo kǒu dai chà diǎn méi kàn jiàn.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.zh: 我还以为不能和家人一起去了。
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ hái yǐ wéi bù néng hé jiā rén yì qǐ qù le.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ men zěn me huì liú xià nǐ ne?

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.zh: 下次放好，就不会着急了。
dialogues.pinyin: Xià cì fàng hǎo, jiù bú huì zháo jí le.
dialogues.tr: Bir dahaki sefere yerine koyarsan endişelenmezsin.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.zh: 你找东西的时候，我会帮你的。
dialogues.pinyin: Nǐ zhǎo dōng xi de shí hòu, wǒ huì bāng nǐ de.
dialogues.tr: Eşyalarını ararken ben sana yardım ederim.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.zh: 谢谢姐姐，也谢谢爸爸妈妈。
dialogues.pinyin: Xiè xiè jiě jie, yě xiè xiè bà ba mā ma.
dialogues.tr: Teşekkürler abla, size de teşekkürler anne, baba.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Sì zhāng piào, xiàn zài dōu zài zhè lǐ.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Zhè cì ràng wǒ ná zhe ba.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Mā ma de bāo fàng zài mén páng biān.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ piào gěi mā ma.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Chū mén qián hái yào kàn kàn shí jiān.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Shí jiān hái gòu, bù yòng pǎo.
dialogues.tr: Yeterince zamanımız var, koşmamıza gerek yok.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Nà wǒ bǎ shuǐ fàng huí bāo lǐ.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Xiǎo chē hé bǐng gān wǒ zì jǐ fàng.
dialogues.tr: Oyuncak araba ve kurabiyeleri kendim koyayım.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Nǐ de bāo kě yǐ guān shàng le.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Yǔ tóng, māo bāo yě ná hǎo.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Mī mī zài lǐ miàn, wǒ kàn zhe tā.
dialogues.tr: Mimi içinde, ben ona göz kulak olurum.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Mī mī yě bù yòng zhǎo piào le ba?
dialogues.tr: Mimi'nin de bilet aramasına gerek yok, değil mi?

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.zh: 咪咪的事爸爸已经安排好了。
dialogues.pinyin: Mī mī de shì bà ba yǐ jīng ān pái hǎo le.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Nǐ xiān guǎn hǎo zì jǐ de bāo.
dialogues.tr: Sen önce kendi çantana dikkat et.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Nǐ de xiǎo kǒu dai xiàn zài kōng le.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.zh: 嗯，下次我会记住放哪儿。
dialogues.pinyin: Èn, xià cì wǒ huì jì zhù fàng nǎr.
dialogues.tr: Evet, bir dahaki sefere nereye koyduğumu hatırlayacağım.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ men qù chē zhàn ba.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ ná piào hé zhè ge bāo.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ ná māo bāo, lè le gēn zhe wǒ.
dialogues.tr: Ben kedi çantasını alıyorum, Lele beni takip etsin.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Lái le, wǒ jiù zài jiě jie páng biān.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Děng yí xià, wǒ bǎ mén guān hǎo.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Hái zi men, dōu zài zhè lǐ ma?

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Dōu zài, jiù děng bà ba le.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Bà ba kuài lái, wǒ men yì qǐ zǒu!
